changing=False
class M(type):
 def mro(cls):
  global changing
  if changing:
   changing=False
   cls.__bases__=(D,)
  return type.mro(cls)

class D: pass
class C(A,metaclass=M): pass
changing=True

print(C.__bases__==(D,),C.__mro__==(C,D,object))
